sentences.text:
Mr. Jnyanananda, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opp. Party
 Mr. S.C. Pradhan , Asc
 Coram: Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
Order Order

02.
 1.
The petitioner is an accused in connection with Junagarh P.S. Case No.249 of 2024 corresponding to C.T. Case No.244/39 of 2024-25 (POCSO) for commission of the offences punishable under Sections 363/ 366/ 506/ 376(2)(n) of the IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act,
Bhawanipatna. The petitioner had approached the learned Additional Sessions Judge- cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Bhawanipatna in C.T. Case No.244/39 of 2024-25 (POCSO).
The learned Court below vide its order dated 16.09.2025 rejected the bail application of the petitioner.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner has filed the present petition under 483 of BNSS, 2023 praying for enlargement on bail.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the bail application with liberty to renew his bail plea before the learned trial Court, in view of the subsequent development in the case.
3. Accordingly, the BLAPL is disposed of as withdrawn, granting liberty to the petitioner to renew his bail plea before the learned trial Court, in view of the subsequent development in the case.

(S.S. Mishra) Subhasis Judge Designation: Personal Assistant Location: High Court of Orissa,
Cuttack.
